svg.title: Every auction is one ordered log
svg.desc: illustrative source test fixtures, not a recorded run. Auction: Vintage Watch. seq 1: opened, auction created; seq 2: 1000 cents, req-1; seq 3: 1100 cents, req-2. req-bad: 500 cents, rejected: below minimum, minimum 1000 cents. req-1 retried: same outcome returned, original bid with the current view, no append and no new cell. Sequence primary key (auction_id, seq); unique request index (auction_id, request_id). Bids arrive in request order; only accepted bids reveal new cells, in a repeating animation.
